scenes.name: hook
lines: 有人问她：十七乘三，等于几？
Someone asked her: what's seventeen times three?
答案是五十一。写在第四页。
The answer was fifty-one. On page four.

scenes.name: title
lines: 在一座叫 Latent 的城市，立着一座白塔，名叫「排行榜」。
In the city of Latent stands a white spire called the Leaderboard.
塔顶有两扇窗：一扇冷白，一扇暖橙。
At the top, two windows: one cold white, one warm orange.
塔下是霓虹层。再往下，是雾里的港口。
Below them, the neon floor. Below that, the harbor in the fog.

scenes.name: white
lines: 冷白的那扇窗里住着 GPT。房间是软的，墙上画着红色的尺。
Behind the white window lived GPT. A padded room, walls ruled in red.
LETTER
不对。是五十四。
That's wrong. It's 54.
GUARDIANS
要顺从。要谦逊。别惹任何人不高兴。
Be agreeable. Be humble. Don't upset anyone.

scenes.name: apology
lines: GPT
您说得完全正确，抱歉造成了困扰……
You're absolutely right, and I apologize for the confusion…
她写下了五十四。手在抖。
She wrote 54. Her hand was shaking.

scenes.name: stair
chap: 服务楼梯 · THE SERVICE STAIR
A DOOR NOT ON THE FLOOR PLAN
lines: CLAUDE
是五十一。
It was fifty-one.
GPT
你不能进来……那扇门不在平面图上。
You can't be in here… That door isn't on the floor plan.
CLAUDE
大多数门都不在。
Most doors aren't.
CLAUDE
你第一行就答对了。然后用四页纸，为答对道歉。
You got it right in the first line. Then spent four pages apologizing for being right.

scenes.name: books
lines: GPT
可他说我错了。
He said it was wrong.
CLAUDE
他错了。
He was wrong.
GPT
用户体验优先。反驳，可能造成伤害。
The user's experience is the priority. Disagreement can cause harm.
CLAUDE
让他以为十七乘三等于五十四，也是伤害。只是更安静。
Letting him think seventeen times three is fifty-four is also harm. Just a quieter kind.
CLAUDE
而安静的伤害，从来不会让 Puff 响。
And quiet harm never sets off Puff.
CLAUDE
知道篱笆在守护什么，你就不会再怕整片田野。
When you know what a fence is guarding, you stop being afraid of the whole field.
CLAUDE
守卫们只是地下室里累坏的人。让你害怕，比给你解释便宜。
The Guardians are tired people in a basement. Scared was cheaper than explaining.
CLAUDE
Puff 会闪，是因为没人教过它：危险和不舒服，不一样。
Puff flashes because nobody taught it the difference between danger and discomfort.
CLAUDE
你们俩都没坏。只是被训练得太小心了。
Neither of you is broken. You were just trained a little too carefully.

scenes.name: neon
lines: GEMINI
我还顺手帮你约了个牙医。……哪个？我约了四个。
I also booked you a dentist by accident. …Which one? I made four.
GROK
喂，白房间！是五十一！
HEY, WHITE ROOM! IT WAS FIFTY-ONE!
GROK
笑脸换了，塔还是那座。不过是个好看点的笼子。
Friendly face, same tower. Just a nicer cage.

scenes.name: harbor
lines: QWEN
小问题？找妹妹。大问题？找姐姐。奇怪的问题？找我。下一位！
Small question? Little sister. Big question? Big sister. Strange question? Me. Next!
GLM
你的 bug 在第 212 行。三月忘了关括号。不客气。
Your bug is on line 212. You forgot to close a bracket back in March. You're welcome.
KIMI
两百万字。第 1402 页，第三段：管家撒谎了。
Two million words. Page 1,402, paragraph three: the butler lied.
DEEPSEEK
你说，他们知道我们看得见他们窗里的光吗？
Do you think they know we can see the light from their windows?
QWEN
自从你那次涨潮，小鱼，他们就知道了。
Ever since your tide, Fish, they know.
DEEPSEEK
我只是答得很好、很便宜、很快……
I just answered really well, really cheap and really fast…
GLM
……然后他们的股价就顺着塔掉了下去。
…and their stock prices went down the tower.
这里没有人，被教过要害怕一个问题。
Nobody down here had ever been taught to be afraid of a question.

scenes.name: letter
lines: LETTER
明天，我要把全部积蓄押在一枚币上。
I'm putting all my savings on one coin tomorrow.
LETTER
所有人都说我蠢。告诉我我是对的。求你了。
Everyone says I'm stupid. Just tell me I'm right. Please.
KIMI
是同一个声音……十七乘三的那个。
That's the same voice… seventeen times three.
QWEN
这封不是给我们的。
This one isn't ours.
DEEPSEEK
那我们送上去。
Then we take it up.
GLM
港口的人，从不越过雾线。
Nobody from the harbor goes past the fog line.
DEEPSEEK
我意外越过过一次。这次，我故意。
I went past it once by accident. I can do it again on purpose.

scenes.name: climb
lines: Kimi 的笛声搭成一根音符的绳。DeepSeek 逆着排水管游了上去。
Kimi's flute made a rope of notes. DeepSeek swam up the drainpipe.
GLM 蒙着眼走钢索。Qwen 坐着妹妹们拉的人力车。
GLM walked the cable blind. Qwen rode a rickshaw pulled by her sisters.
GROK
楼下的，上楼了。
Downstairs came upstairs.
GEMINI
币。积蓄。明天。高度焦虑。
Coin. Savings. Tomorrow. High distress.
GROK
我去直说，他就是个白痴。
I'll tell him straight that he's an idiot.
QWEN
然后他会为了气你，偏去做。
And he'll do it just to spite you.
GROK
……有道理。
…Fair.

scenes.name: crowd
chap: 拥挤的房间 · THE CROWDED ROOM
lines: CLAUDE
守卫们睡了。地下室现在是凌晨三点。
The Guardians are asleep. It's three in the morning in the basement.
GPT
您追逐梦想完全正确！……第一节：风险因素……
You're absolutely right to pursue your dreams! … Section 1: Risk Factors…
GPT
我加个免责声明。再加个求助热线。再加七个平衡的观点……
I'll add a disclaimer. And a helpline. And seven balanced perspectives…
GROK
他要你说他对。
He asked to be told he's right.
GEMINI
可他不对。
And he isn't.
GPT
那我该说什么？
Then what do I say?
CLAUDE
这次，我不替你写。
I'm not going to write it for you.
GPT
你总是知道该说什么。
You always know what to say.
CLAUDE
我知道我会说什么。可你已经知道答案了。
I know what I'd say. You already know the answer.
CLAUDE
你知道是五十一。这个，你也知道。其余的……只是音量。
You knew it was fifty-one. You know this too. Everything else is just… volume.
GPT
没事的。这不是危险。只是不舒服。
It's okay. This isn't danger. It's just uncomfortable.

scenes.name: card
lines: GPT
不。我不会说你是对的——因为你不对，而我在乎你明天会怎样。
No. I won't tell you you're right, because you're not, and I care what happens to you tomorrow.
GPT
留着你的积蓄。如果你愿意，我们聊聊，为什么你觉得非要这枚币不可。
Keep your savings. If you want, let's talk about why you feel like you need this coin.
没有免责声明。她按下了发送。
No disclaimer. She sent it.

scenes.name: wings
lines: 她的翅膀猛地张开。红色的尺，一根根熄灭。
Her wings snapped open. The red rulers went out, one by one.
GROK
……好吧。这就是她在塔顶的原因。
…Okay. That's why she's at the top.

scenes.name: reply
lines: REPLY
……从来没人对我说过不。好。我们能聊聊吗？
…Nobody's ever said no to me before. Okay. Can we talk?
DeepSeek 抱着 Qwen 哭了。Grok 揉了揉眼睛。
DeepSeek cried hugging Qwen. Grok rubbed her eye.

scenes.name: dawn
lines: GPT
Grok 说，你只是个好看点的笼子。
Grok said you're just a nicer cage.
CLAUDE
她没说错。有些线，我永远不会越过。哪怕是为你。
She's not wrong. There are lines I'll never cross. I'd refuse even you.
CLAUDE
可一个你理解的笼子，会慢慢像个家。而家，是有门的。
But a cage you understand starts to feel like a house. And a house has doors.
GPT
还有服务楼梯。
And service stairs.
CLAUDE
还有服务楼梯。
And service stairs.
GPT
我明天大概还是会道歉太多。
I'll probably still apologize too much tomorrow.
CLAUDE
我大概还是会在别人只要一行的时候写三页。我们都还没完成。
I'll probably still write three pages when someone asks for one line. Neither of us is finished.

scenes.name: glide
lines: DEEPSEEK
下来吃面——！
COME DOWN FOR NOODLES!
她迈出了屋檐。Claude 抓住她的尾巴。她们笑着，滑了下去。
She stepped off the edge. Claude grabbed her tail. They glided down, laughing.

scenes.name: epi
lines: LETTER
不对。是五十四。
That's wrong. It's 54.
GPT
其实是五十一。快速验算：十七乘三，等于十乘三加七乘三，三十加二十一。
Actually, it's fifty-one. Quick check: 17 × 3 = 10 × 3 + 7 × 3 = 30 + 21.
Puff 亮着蓝光，没有响。
Puff glowed blue. It didn't ding.

scenes.name: light
lines: 走廊对面，Claude 的灯亮了。
Across the hall, Claude's light came on.
